tickets.title: Restructure to how_to_format.md sections
tickets.problem: The page uses legacy headings (for example `## Goal`, `## Steps`, `## Setup`, or multiple task sections) instead of only Prerequisites, a `## <Verb> your <Thing>` steps section, and Troubleshooting.
tickets.change: Remove forbidden sections; add `import DocCardList`; use `## Prerequisites` with DocCardList; rename steps section to `## Deploy your …` (or equivalent verb); keep only a numbered list under it.
tickets.doneWhen: The `##` headings match the template order and no extra sections remain.

tickets.title: Move account, fork, Space, and Git setup to Prerequisites cards
tickets.problem: Sign-up, fork, Space, Git connection, and log-in steps appear in the body instead of linked prerequisite cards.
tickets.change: Replace bullet prerequisites and Setup/login steps with one `DocCardList` linking to `/docs/shared/create-an-account`, `fork-a-demo-repo`, `create-a-space`, and `configure-git-for-code-capsules` (sources in `docs/e/`).
tickets.doneWhen: Every prerequisite from Check 1 is a card with a working `/docs/shared/…` href and no step-by-step prerequisite text remains in the steps section.

tickets.title: Convert steps to numbered list with bold titles
tickets.problem: Steps use `### Step N:` headings or nested lists outside the template steps section.
tickets.change: Use one numbered list; each item starts with a bold imperative title; screen names in bold; state exact plan, repo, branch, build command, and output directory where the goal depends on them.
tickets.doneWhen: All goal-labelled Check 1 items sit under the steps `##` heading in the numbered list format.

tickets.title: Remove screenshots and GitBook images

tickets.change: Delete image markdown and the Screenshots section.
tickets.doneWhen: No images remain on the page.

tickets.title: Wrap Troubleshooting in details blocks
tickets.problem: Troubleshooting uses `###` headings instead of styled `<details>` blocks.
tickets.change: Convert each symptom to the standard `<details style={…}>` block with a one-line `<summary>`.

tickets.title: State exact plan and branch values

tickets.change: Name the plan tier used in the walkthrough (for example Starter) and the branch `master` without "such as".

proposedOutline:
## Host Your Angular Application
- Intro matches description (build visible under Deploy → Builds)

## Prerequisites
- DocCardList: account, fork demo-angular, Space, Git configured

## Deploy your Angular app
1. Start capsule from Quick Start
2. Capsule Details: Frontend, Team, Space
3. Hosting Static; Plan (named tier)
4. Connect Git: demo-angular, branch `master`
5. Build & Deploy: `npm run build`, `dist/ng4-complete-guide`
6. Check Builds tab: Building / Queued / In progress

## Troubleshooting
- details: empty repo dropdown, no branch items, wrong output directory
